name: keraladb
title: KeralaDB: a recipe-level nutrition database for Kerala cuisine linked to the Indian Food Composition Tables (IFCT 2017)
description: KeralaDB links 131 Kerala recipes (1,582 ingredient lines) to the Indian Food Composition Tables 2017, with gaps filled from the Indian Nutrient Databank (INDB) and USDA FoodData Central. Every ingredient line carries a parsed quantity, unit and gram weight, and a link to a per-100 g nutrient profile, giving per-serving energy, protein, carbohydrate and fat for each recipe. Every linkage and conversion decision records how it was made. Recipe instructions are not redistributed; each recipe links to its source page.

sources.title: Jain, K. (2020). 6000+ Indian Food Recipes Dataset, v1. Mendeley Data (recipes scraped from archanaskitchen.com)
Longvah, T., Ananthan, R., Bhaskarachary, K., Venkaiah, K. (2017). Indian Food Composition Tables. National Institute of Nutrition, ICMR
Vijayakumar, A., et al. (2024). Development of an Indian Food Composition Database (INDB). Current Developments in Nutrition
U.S. Department of Agriculture, Agricultural Research Service. FoodData Central (SR Legacy)
Public Health England. McCance and Widdowson's The Composition of Foods Integrated Dataset (CoFID); source of the INDB supplementary rows

resources.name: recipe_nutrition
resources.title: Per-serving nutrition by recipe
resources.description: Start here. One row per recipe: estimated energy and macronutrients per serving, and how much of the recipe those numbers cover. Values are sums over raw ingredients; no cooking losses or yields applied.

fields.name: recipe_id
fields.title: Recipe ID
fields.description: Recipe identifier; see recipes.

fields.name: dish_name
fields.title: Dish name
fields.description: Recipe title, repeated from recipes for convenience.

fields.name: servings
fields.title: Servings
fields.description: Servings used as the divisor for every per-serving value; see recipes.servings.

fields.name: n_lines
fields.title: Ingredient lines
fields.description: Number of ingredient lines in the recipe.

fields.name: n_linked
fields.title: Lines linked
fields.description: Lines whose ingredient is linked to a nutrient profile (any source_db).

fields.name: n_grams
fields.title: Lines with grams
fields.description: Lines with a gram weight.

fields.name: n_counted
fields.title: Lines counted
fields.description: Lines with BOTH a gram weight and a nutrient profile: the only lines that contribute to the per-serving values.

fields.name: coverage_lines
fields.title: Line coverage
fields.description: n_counted / n_lines (0-1).

fields.name: coverage_mass
fields.title: Mass coverage
fields.description: Share of the recipe's ingredient mass that is linked to a nutrient profile (0-1), excluding salt and water. The dataset's headline coverage metric, aggregated over all recipes.

fields.name: low_coverage
fields.title: Low coverage
fields.description: true when coverage_mass is below 0.90: a substantial ingredient has no nutrient profile, so the per-serving values are underestimates and should not be used as complete.

fields.name: kcal_per_serving
fields.title: Energy (kcal/serving)
fields.description: Energy per serving in kilocalories.

fields.name: protein_g_per_serving
fields.title: Protein (g/serving)
fields.description: Protein per serving, grams.

fields.name: carb_g_per_serving
fields.title: Carbohydrate (g/serving)
fields.description: Carbohydrate per serving, grams. See nutrients.carb_g for how carbohydrate is defined in each source.

fields.name: fat_g_per_serving
fields.title: Fat (g/serving)
fields.description: Total fat per serving, grams.

resources.name: recipes
resources.title: Recipes
resources.description: One row per recipe: the Kerala-labelled recipes of the source dataset, after removing untranslated recipes and confirmed duplicates.

fields.name: recipe_id
fields.title: Recipe ID
fields.description: KeralaDB recipe identifier.

fields.name: dish_name
fields.title: Dish name
fields.description: Recipe title in English as given by the source. A few titles end in '(Recipe In Hindi)' because the source page was the Hindi edition of the recipe.

fields.name: servings
fields.title: Servings
fields.description: Number of servings used for every per-serving value. Equal to servings_source unless the value was corrected after checking the source page.

fields.name: servings_source
fields.title: Servings in source dataset
fields.description: Servings as recorded in the source dataset (Jain 2020). Differs from servings on the few recipes that were corrected against the source page.

fields.name: source_id
fields.title: Source record
fields.description: Srno of the recipe in the source dataset (Jain 2020).

fields.name: source_url
fields.title: Source URL
fields.description: The original recipe page. Instructions are not redistributed in this dataset; follow this link for them.

resources.name: recipe_ingredients
resources.title: Recipe ingredient lines
resources.description: One row per ingredient line of each recipe, parsed into quantity, unit and name, with an estimated weight and a link to the ingredient.

fields.name: recipe_id
fields.title: Recipe ID
fields.description: Recipe the line belongs to.

fields.name: line_no
fields.title: Line number
fields.description: Position of the line in the recipe's ingredient list. Numbers can skip where a fragment that was not an ingredient was removed.

fields.name: raw_line
fields.title: Ingredient line as written
fields.description: The ingredient line as it appears in the source, e.g. '1/2 teaspoon Turmeric powder (Haldi)'.

fields.name: qty
fields.title: Quantity as written
fields.description: Quantity text: '1', '3/4', '1-1/2'. Blank when the line states none ('salt to taste').

fields.name: qty_num
fields.title: Quantity
fields.description: qty as a decimal number: '1-1/2' -> 1.5.

fields.name: unit
fields.title: Unit as written
fields.description: Unit named in the line, normalised to one spelling. Blank when the line names none.

fields.name: unit_key
fields.title: Unit used for conversion
fields.description: The unit looked up in unit_conversions: the parsed unit, else '(count)' or '(none)'.

fields.name: grams
fields.title: Weight (g)
fields.description: Estimated weight of the line in grams: qty_num x the gram value in unit_conversions, or that value alone when there is no quantity. Blank for six 'water as required' lines.

fields.name: name_raw
fields.title: Ingredient name as written
fields.description: Ingredient name with quantity, unit and preparation removed. Joins to synonyms.name_raw.

fields.name: state
fields.title: Preparation
fields.description: Preparation or form as written ('grated', 'finely chopped'). Free text.

fields.name: dry_fresh
fields.title: Dry / fresh
fields.description: Whether the line specifies a dry or fresh form.

fields.name: parse_status
fields.title: Parse status
fields.description: How the line's quantity, unit and name were decided.

fields.name: ingredient_id
fields.title: Ingredient ID
fields.description: The canonical ingredient this line names; see ingredients.

resources.name: ingredients
resources.title: Ingredients and their nutrient links
resources.description: One row per canonical ingredient used by a recipe in this release, with the food-composition entry it is linked to and a record of how that link was made.

fields.name: ingredient_id
fields.title: Ingredient ID
fields.description: KeralaDB ingredient identifier.

fields.name: norm_key
fields.title: Canonical key
fields.description: The ingredient name reduced to a comparison key: lowercased, nouns singularised, digits and one-letter tokens removed. 'Green Chillies' -> 'green chilli'.

fields.name: generic_name
fields.title: Ingredient name
fields.description: Readable name of the ingredient.

fields.name: food_code
fields.title: Food code
fields.description: Code of the linked nutrient profile; see nutrients.food_code for the code ranges. Blank when no source has the food.

fields.name: food_name
fields.title: Linked food
fields.description: Name of the linked nutrient profile, from nutrients.

fields.name: source_db
fields.title: Nutrient source
fields.description: Which database the nutrient profile comes from. Blank when absent.

fields.name: link_status
fields.title: Link status
fields.description: Whether the ingredient has a nutrient profile.

fields.name: link_method
fields.title: Link method
fields.description: How the link was decided. Every ingredient was reviewed by a person.

fields.name: match_rule
fields.title: Matcher rule
fields.description: The first rung of the string-matching ladder that found any IFCT candidate. Describes the machine's evidence, not the final decision.

fields.name: candidate_rank
fields.title: Candidate rank
fields.description: Position of the chosen food in the matcher's ranked candidate list (1 = top). Blank when the food was not among the candidates.

fields.name: hierarchical
fields.title: Proxy link
fields.description: Whether the link is a proxy (hierarchical match, after Kalra et al. 2020). Blank when absent.

fields.name: n_lines
fields.title: Lines using it
fields.description: Number of recipe lines in this release that use the ingredient (always at least 1).

fields.name: notes
fields.title: Notes
fields.description: Reviewer's note on the linking decision.

resources.name: synonyms
resources.title: Synonym table
resources.description: Every ingredient name as written in the recipes, the canonical key it normalises to, and the food it is linked to. Names sharing a food_code are treated as the same food: 'okra' and 'Bhindi (Lady Finger/Okra)' both resolve to IFCT D056 Ladies finger.

fields.name: name_raw
fields.title: Name as written
fields.description: Ingredient name exactly as written in a recipe.

fields.name: norm_key
fields.title: Canonical key
fields.description: Key the name normalises to.

fields.name: ingredient_id
fields.title: Ingredient ID
fields.description: Canonical ingredient; see ingredients.

fields.name: food_code
fields.title: Food code
fields.description: Linked nutrient profile. Blank when absent.

fields.name: food_name
fields.title: Linked food
fields.description: Name of the linked nutrient profile.

fields.name: n_lines
fields.title: Lines
fields.description: Recipe lines in this release that use this spelling.

resources.name: unit_conversions
resources.title: Unit-to-gram conversions
resources.description: Gram weight for each (ingredient, unit) pair used in the recipes, and the source of that weight.

fields.name: ingredient_id
fields.title: Ingredient ID
fields.description: Ingredient; see ingredients.

fields.name: norm_key
fields.title: Canonical key
fields.description: Ingredient key, repeated for readability.

fields.name: unit
fields.title: Unit
fields.description: Unit, as in recipe_ingredients.unit_key.

fields.name: has_qty
fields.title: Per unit?
fields.description: true: grams is the weight of ONE unit and is multiplied by the line's quantity ('2 sprigs' -> 2 x 2 g). false: grams is the weight of the whole line, which states no quantity ('a few sprigs' -> 4 g).

fields.name: grams
fields.title: Grams
fields.description: Gram weight (per unit, or per line; see has_qty).

fields.name: method
fields.title: Method
fields.description: Where the gram value comes from.

fields.name: by_analogy
fields.title: By analogy
fields.description: true when the value was taken from a similar food (e.g. pumpkin cup weight from white gourd) because the source lists none for this one.

fields.name: assigned_by
fields.title: Assigned by
fields.description: Whether the value was filled automatically or by a person.

fields.name: notes
fields.title: Notes
fields.description: Basis of the value (source row, rule line, reasoning).

resources.name: nutrients
resources.title: Nutrient profiles (per 100 g)
resources.description: Per-100 g energy and macronutrients for every food linked by an ingredient. Values from IFCT 2017 unless data_source says otherwise.

fields.name: food_code
fields.title: Food code
fields.description: IFCT 2017 code (e.g. G033); INDB supplementary code (5xx); USDA FoodData Central food, lettered by IFCT food group (6xx); KeralaDB derived composite (9xx); or KeralaDB local code (LOC*).

fields.name: food_name
fields.title: Food
fields.description: Food name as published by the source.

fields.name: food_group
fields.title: Food group
fields.description: IFCT food group; 'INDB supplementary', 'USDA supplementary', 'Derived' or 'Local' for non-IFCT rows.

fields.name: data_source
fields.title: Data source
fields.description: Database the values come from.

fields.name: energy_kcal
fields.title: Energy (kcal/100 g)
fields.description: Energy in kilocalories. IFCT rows: published kJ / 4.184, or computed with Atwater general factors (4/4/9) where IFCT publishes none. Other rows: as published by their source; see energy_source.

fields.name: energy_kj
fields.title: Energy (kJ/100 g)
fields.description: Energy in kilojoules as published. Blank on Atwater-derived rows.

fields.name: energy_source
fields.title: Energy source
fields.description: How energy_kcal was obtained.

fields.name: protein_g
fields.title: Protein (g/100 g)
fields.description: Protein, grams per 100 g.

fields.name: carb_g
fields.title: Carbohydrate (g/100 g)
fields.description: Carbohydrate, grams per 100 g. IFCT rows: available carbohydrate by difference (excludes fibre). USDA rows: carbohydrate by difference minus fibre, or carbohydrate by difference where the source reports no fibre (stated in source_ref). INDB rows: as published in the UK table, in monosaccharide equivalents.

fields.name: fat_g
fields.title: Fat (g/100 g)
fields.description: Total fat, grams per 100 g.

fields.name: fibre_g
fields.title: Fibre (g/100 g)
fields.description: Total dietary fibre, grams per 100 g. Blank where the source reports none. Not used in per-serving values.

fields.name: source_ref
fields.title: Source reference
fields.description: For non-IFCT rows: the originating database row, or how a derived value was computed.
